data.text: Set as trap on your location. Target cannot perform any basic action except Empty Posture (not even Empty Move). On trap resolve: becomes Permanent with power 20 point-buy.

logic.description: Implemented (2026-10-29). The card lies face down under the caster; the first enemy that steps onto the tile springs it: the caster gains the card as a permanent (fixed power 6, Rule 24 — user ruling 2026-10-30: "power 20 is my bad") and the victim can only Empty Posture while that permanent stands. Trap card routing per user ruling 2026-10-30 (see trap_card_routing).

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Power of the trap / resulting permanent: 20 (×2 when ∀).
Basic actions the trapped target may still play: only Empty Posture (1 of 6 codes).
Springs on the first enemy that steps onto the trap tile.
While the owner holds the sprung permanent: the victim can only Empty Posture.

User ruling 2026-10-30: a trap under its owner goes back to the OWNER's discard pile; a trap on an unoccupied tile (enter trigger) goes to the discard pile of the unit that dealt with it (sprang it, or a Cleric with someone on the tile). Library-generated traps only ever exist as that card for the one who dealt with them.
